data.body: NOTE (path update 2026-04-29): The skill-trace breadcrumb system referenced by this epic (SKILL_INVOKE / SKILL_RESUMED / SKILL_ENTER / SKILL_EXIT, plugins/dso/scripts/skill-trace-analyze, plugins/dso/docs/SKILL-TRACE-FORMAT.md) has been removed during a refactor of /dso:implementation-plan. SKILL_RESUMED is no longer emitted anywhere in the plugin. This epic's premise needs re-scoping during /dso:brainstorm review — the proposed PostToolUse hook will need to source next-step signals from elsewhere (e.g., REVIEW_RESULT, COMPLETION_VERIFIER_VERDICT, structured STATUS lines) rather than the trace system.
